lastText: The Campaign EndsThe Long ExileNew Ending Found · 1 / 16SCHOLAR AND SERVANT VANISH WITHOUT TRACEThe west tower is found three days later, cold and empty, exactly as it stood the night the work stopped. Vats intact, notes untouched, as if its occupant simply set down his instruments and walked out the postern gate. He did. Reports place a man matching Victor Frankenstein’s description, and a companion no witness will describe consistently twice, on a mountain road north of the city, and then nowhere at all. Neither Ingolstadt nor Geneva ever hears from him again. Whether that is mercy or cowardice, the tower’s cold vats decline to say. The stories that travel furthest agree on very little except this: whatever Victor built wanted, above all, not to be alone. Witnesses describe it lingering near lit windows on cold nights, never entering, never quite leaving either.
